title: sdlc shared project configuration (.agents/sdlc.json)
description: Generated by `npm run config:docs` from lib/config-schema.mjs. Do not hand-edit; see docs/configuration.md.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema file, for editor validation; has no effect on pipeline behavior.

version.description: Schema version for `.agents/sdlc.json`; only `1` is recognized today.

name.description: Lane identifier; must match /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/ and be unique among targets.

paths.description: Glob patterns whose changed files belong to this target.

gates.description: Quality-gate commands run in addition to the top-level gates when this target is selected.

reviewers.description: Reviewer profiles for this target; inherits the top-level reviewers when omitted.

targets.description: Ordered list of named work lanes; declaration order sets precedence when target paths overlap.

gates.description: Quality-gate commands run for every target.

reviewers.description: Default reviewer profiles for targets that do not declare their own.

productDocs.description: Repository-relative directory of durable product documentation.

frontendConstraints.description: Prose constraints frontend reviewers and implementers must honor.

mode.description: Beads coordination backend: an embedded local store or a shared server.

mergeSlot.description: Whether the single-writer merge slot is enforced before landing.

reviewEditor.description: Command template that opens a worktree in the developer's editor; machine-scoped.

command.description: Command template that starts a local preview server; machine-scoped.

url.description: URL template for the local preview server; machine-scoped.

tier.description: Fallback model tier for roles that do not declare their own.

effort.description: Fallback reasoning effort for roles that do not declare their own.

tier.description: Model tier for this role; falls back to models.defaults.tier.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this role; falls back to models.defaults.effort.

roles.description: Per-role tier/effort overrides; role names are open-ended.

frontier.description: Concrete model identifier a host resolves this tier to.
